हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/rfWxT4
show.description: A manipulative woman deceives her wealthy fiancé while secretly living a double life. After publicly humiliating an elderly man—insulting him and destroying a cherished memory—she discovers he is a powerful billionaire with the influence to ruin her. Determined to expose her lies, he sets out to bring her true nature to light and make her face the consequences before everyone.
